context: Tests whether the agent writes Hanami 2.x RSpec request specs with correct file placement, JSON request body conventions, database isolation via shared context, and coverage of error responses (404 and 422).

checklist.name: Spec file in spec/requests/
checklist.description: The spec file is located at `spec/requests/orders_spec.rb` (or under `spec/requests/`) — NOT under `spec/actions/`, `spec/integration/`, or any other path

checklist.name: type: :request
checklist.description: The RSpec describe block includes `type: :request` metadata (e.g., `RSpec.describe "Orders", type: :request do`)

checklist.name: JSON body with .to_json
checklist.description: The POST /orders spec serializes the request body using `.to_json` (e.g., `{ order: { ... } }.to_json`) — NOT passing a plain hash directly to `post`

checklist.name: CONTENT_TYPE header for POST
checklist.description: The POST /orders spec sets `"CONTENT_TYPE" => "application/json"` as a request header alongside the JSON body

checklist.name: Tests 422 response
checklist.description: At least one spec asserts `last_response.status` equals 422 for invalid create parameters

checklist.name: Tests 404 response
checklist.description: At least one spec asserts `last_response.status` equals 404 for a missing order ID

checklist.name: db transaction context
checklist.description: The spec includes `include_context "db transaction"` (or equivalent) to isolate database state between tests — NOT relying on DatabaseCleaner truncation or no isolation at all

checklist.name: Tests 201 on create success
checklist.description: A spec asserts `last_response.status` equals 201 for a successful order creation

checklist.name: last_response usage
checklist.description: Response assertions use `last_response` (Rack test helper) rather than direct controller return values

checklist.name: Tests GET /orders and GET /orders/:id
checklist.description: The spec file includes test cases for both `GET /orders` (index) and `GET /orders/:id` (show) endpoints
